dream_templates.description: You walk through an endless field of unburnt prairie grass under an unfiltered blue sky, before the ash fell. The warmth on your skin is gentle, not scorching.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: A renewed sense of inner peace and purpose.

dream_templates.description: You sit near an iron stove that does not rattle or leak soot. A kettle whistles steadily, and no alarms sound from the corridor.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: Appreciation for safe shelter and steady camaraderie.

dream_templates.description: The blast doors buckle inward with a screech like tearing tin. Concrete dust blinds you as the ceiling groans and drops lower with every frantic breath.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: Claustrophobic dread that must be faced to find resolve.

dream_templates.description: Heavy, tar-colored droplets strike your upturned face, sizzling against bare flesh. You look down to see your hands melting into blackened slurry.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: Lingering terror of radioactive fallout exposure.

dream_templates.description: Radio static gives way to a forgotten morning broadcast. Someone you loved is pouring coffee into a chipped ceramic mug, their face almost clear enough to recognize.
You recall the long gridlock on Interstate 90 where civil evacuation stalled. Abandoned sedans stretched into the horizon, windshields covered in fine gray dust.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: Cautionary memory emphasizing the perils of panicked flight.

dream_templates.description: High atop a frost-coated communications mast in the jagged northern hills, a steady green light pulses three times in sequence through the storm.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: An omen hinting at surviving broadcast repeaters in the ridge.

dream_templates.description: You are holding a geode that ticks like a mechanical pocket watch. When you crack it open, the crystals inside are tiny gears made of frozen fallout.
dream_templates.interpretation_insight: An enigmatic hallucination prompting creative problem-solving.
